about: Fixed vectors for the keyword rule and the rank merge: src/search.rs and web/app.js (tests/serve_frontend.cjs) check the same cases. Title and URL only: the Library holds no page text. Synthetic pages.

pick.about: without a ranking, every match in library order
without a ranking or words, every page
ranked pages first in the service's order, matched or not, then the unindexed matches; a key no page has is ignored
an empty ranking leaves the keyword matches

known_differences.about: Documented only, outside the equality vectors: duplicate ranked keys keep their first position in Rust and their last in web/app.js. The bundled service cannot produce duplicates: Archive.load uses a set, dataset.app_records iterates those unique keys, engine.sync deduplicates and replaces existing rows, and engine.order returns each row once (lab/tagger/tests/test_rank.py checks this). The detailed CLI contract rejects duplicate keys from a replacement service; this legacy merge example documents the web behavior.
Documented only, outside the equality vectors: Rust split_whitespace treats U+0085 as whitespace; JavaScript /\s+/ does not.
Documented only, outside the equality vectors: JavaScript /\s+/ treats U+FEFF as whitespace; Rust split_whitespace does not.
